properties.name: north_america_coverage_bbox
properties.role: common bounding extent enclosing the 100-statute-mile buffered landmass

metadata.buffer_method: Geodesic buffer of authoritative coastline geometry (Natural Earth 1:10m coastline / GSHHG equivalent) using a geodesic engine (pyproj.Geod, WGS84): 160.934 km (100 statute miles) outward from relevant coastlines; buffer unioned with included land geometry (Alaska, Canadian mainland, Arctic islands, CONUS, Mexico, Central America, Caribbean islands, Greenland); single common bbox enclosing the union, rounded outward to clean values.
coverage_includes: Surrounding coastal waters within the offshore buffer

margins.east: ~1 deg beyond buffered east-Greenland coast (tight, noted)
margins.west: antimeridian edge -180 covers all buffered Alaska

do_not_claim: Rectangular offshore buffer following the coastline (it does not; the bbox encloses the coastline-following buffer)
Complete weather-data coverage everywhere inside the bbox (sources have gaps; gaps stay transparent)
